Pilot every candidate across the chosen models/frameworks. Use pass rate, dependent depth, tool calls, recovery success and tokens per success to calibrate structural labels.
Keep related evidence families together in development/test partitions and report family-level coverage. Do not count near-duplicate arithmetic questions as independent evidence of breadth.
Sample by difficulty and capability jointly; the current CLI samples by task_type only. Ensure any new selector/export preserves framework parity and reports exact dataset version/hash.
